relations.notes: Kievan Rus'-era East Slavs are the common precursor of Russians, Ukrainians and Belarusians.

peoples.brief_en: A Germanic people that established a kingdom centered in North Africa.
peoples.brief_zh: 建立过以北非为核心王国的日耳曼人群。

relations.notes: Vandals are conventionally classified within East Germanic in many modern reference works, but details of their linguistic/historical classification are debated.

peoples.brief_en: A branch of the Goths prominent in late Roman Gaul and Iberia.
peoples.brief_zh: 哥特人的一个分支，在晚期罗马高卢和伊比利亚历史中非常重要。

relations.notes: Visigoths are conventionally treated as a branch/group of the Goths.

peoples.brief_en: Turkic people and trading state on the Volga-Kama (937-1240).
peoples.brief_zh: 伏尔加-卡马河的突厥语族群及其商业国家（937–1240）。

peoples.brief_en: The modern people of Wales.
peoples.brief_zh: 现代威尔士族群。

people_region.caveat_zh: 图伦/伊赫什德（868–969，突厥裔）、阿尤布（1171–1250，库尔德裔）、马穆鲁克（1250–1517，突厥—切尔克斯裔）统治集团非阿拉伯人，本图无对应族群，按阿拉伯化的埃及国家近似着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The Tulunid/Ikhshidid (868–969, Turkic), Ayyubid (1171–1250, Kurdish) and Mamluk (1250–1517, Turkic–Circassian) ruling elites were not Arab; with no corresponding people in this atlas, Egypt is colored as an Arabized Egyptian state.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1517–1798 奥斯曼（马穆鲁克贝伊实掌）、1805–1882 穆罕默德·阿里王朝自治、1882–1952 英国占领/保护：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与殖民政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1517–1798 Ottoman (with Mamluk beys in power), 1805–1882 autonomous Muhammad Ali dynasty, 1882–1952 British occupation/protectorate: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or colonial political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1541–1686/1699 年为奥斯曼布达、特梅什瓦尔等帕夏辖区，北部山地属王室匈牙利；按着色原则不画奥斯曼与哈布斯堡政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1541–1686/1699: the Ottoman eyalets of Buda and Temesvár, with the northern hills in Royal Hungary; following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or Habsburg political layer is drawn and the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 前 60–前 44 年达契亚布雷比斯塔王国一度支配蒂萨河流域。
people_region.caveat_en: In 60–44 BC the Dacian kingdom of Burebista briefly dominated the Tisza basin.

people_region.caveat_zh: 805 年起第一保加利亚帝国（克鲁姆）据蒂萨河以东，本区按斯拉夫人着色。
people_region.caveat_en: From 805 the First Bulgarian Empire (Krum) held the lands east of the Tisza; the region is colored by its Slavic population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 洛林（梅斯）此期属罗马残余与法兰克，非阿勒曼尼人。
people_region.caveat_en: Lorraine (Metz) belonged to Roman remnants and the Franks in this period, not the Alemanni.

people_region.caveat_zh: 洛林公国以法语人口为主（1766 年方并入法国），本区按神圣罗马帝国着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The Duchy of Lorraine was mainly French-speaking (joining France only in 1766); the region is colored by the Holy Roman Empire.

people_region.caveat_zh: 阿尔萨斯与摩泽尔东北通行德语方言；1871–1918 年为德意志帝国帝国领地阿尔萨斯—洛林（1940–1944 再被吞并）。
people_region.caveat_en: Alsace and northeastern Moselle speak German dialects; in 1871–1918 the area was the German imperial territory of Alsace–Lorraine (annexed again in 1940–1944).

people_region.caveat_zh: 金雀花王朝为法语安茹贵族；1224 年后普瓦图、利穆赞相继归法，仅吉耶讷—加斯科涅（约本区西南半）属英格兰王室。
people_region.caveat_en: The Plantagenets were French-speaking Angevins; after 1224 Poitou and the Limousin passed to France, leaving only Guyenne–Gascony (roughly the southwest half of the region) to the English crown.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1243–1335 年伊儿汗国（蒙古）宗主统治，本图无对应族群。
people_region.caveat_en: Ilkhanid (Mongol) suzerainty in 1243–1335; no corresponding people exists in this atlas.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1514–1918 奥斯曼（卡尔斯—阿尔达汉 1878–1918 属俄国）；亚美尼亚人至 1915 年仍为显著少数：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与委任统治政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1514–1918 Ottoman (Kars–Ardahan Russian 1878–1918); Armenians remained a large minority until 1915: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or mandate political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 387 年后西部属拜占庭、东部属萨珊；7–9 世纪阿拉伯阿尔米尼亚总督区宗主；本土亚美尼亚诸侯（纳哈拉尔）与巴格拉提德王国自治，按亚美尼亚人着色。
people_region.caveat_en: After 387 the west was Byzantine and the east Sasanian; in the 7th–9th centuries the Arab emirate of Arminiya held suzerainty. Native Armenian princes (nakharars) and the Bagratid kingdom ruled locally, so the region is colored Armenian.

people_region.caveat_zh: 阿尤布（库尔德裔，1207–1230）与伊儿汗国（蒙古，1243–1335）期按突厥—土库曼统治近似着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The Ayyubid (Kurdish, 1207–1230) and Ilkhanid (Mongol, 1243–1335) periods are approximated as Turkic–Turkmen rule.

people_region.caveat_zh: 约 1800 年起凡湖—比特利斯一带亚美尼亚人与库尔德人混居、比例有争论，此处以亚美尼亚人近似着色。
people_region.caveat_en: From about 1800 the Van–Bitlis area was mixed Armenian and Kurdish in disputed proportions; it is approximated as Armenian here.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1400 年为近似分界：东斯拉夫三族 14–16 世纪逐步分化，此前统一标示为「罗斯人」。白俄罗斯民族在立陶宛大公国治下逐步形成。
people_region.caveat_en: 1400 is an approximate boundary: the three East Slavic peoples differentiated gradually in the 14th–16th centuries and are shown jointly as "Rus'" before it. The Belarusian nationality developed under the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.

people_region.caveat_zh: 基辅罗斯时代的东斯拉夫人统一标示为「罗斯人」，作为俄罗斯人、乌克兰人、白俄罗斯人的共同前身，不将基辅罗斯归属于其中任何一个现代民族。
people_region.caveat_en: East Slavs of the Kievan Rus' era are shown jointly as "Rus'", the common precursor of Russians, Ukrainians and Belarusians, without assigning Kievan Rus' to any one modern nation.

people_region.caveat_zh: 比提尼亚王国为希腊化的色雷斯系王朝，按希腊化世界近似着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The Bithynian kingdom was a Hellenized dynasty of Thracian origin, colored as part of the Hellenistic world.

people_region.caveat_zh: 按人口原则不画奥斯曼政治控制层，仅以土耳其裔/穆斯林少数族群层表示奥斯曼时代遗留人口。
people_region.caveat_en: Following the population principle, no Ottoman political-control layer is drawn; Ottoman-era populations are shown only as a Turkish/Muslim minority layer.

people_region.caveat_zh: 888–1032 年勃艮第/阿尔勒王国，1032 年后东部属神圣罗马帝国：里昂 1312、多菲内 1349、弗朗什孔泰 1678（此前属西班牙哈布斯堡）、萨伏依 1860 年方入法国。本区按法兰西着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The Kingdom of Burgundy/Arles (888–1032), then the Holy Roman Empire, held the east: Lyon joined France in 1312, Dauphiné in 1349, Franche-Comté in 1678 (previously Spanish Habsburg) and Savoy in 1860. The region is colored French.

people_region.caveat_zh: 卡帕多奇亚王国为伊朗系阿里阿拉特王朝，希腊化宫廷；按希腊化世界近似着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The Cappadocian kingdom was ruled by the Iranian Ariarathid dynasty with a Hellenized court; it is colored as part of the Hellenistic world.

people_region.caveat_zh: 以现代族名标示先民人群：711 年起为阿斯图里亚斯—莱昂—卡斯蒂利亚诸王国的基督徒人口；统一的「西班牙人」认同形成于近代早期（1479 年王冠联合之后）。
people_region.caveat_en: Modern ethnonym used for ancestral populations: from 711 the Christian population of the Asturian–Leonese–Castilian kingdoms; a unified Spanish identity formed in the early modern period (after the 1479 union of crowns).

people_region.caveat_zh: 托斯卡纳与斯波莱托公国属伦巴第（751 年伦巴第攻陷拉文纳）；拜占庭仅保罗马公国与拉文纳走廊。
people_region.caveat_en: Tuscany and the Duchy of Spoleto were Lombard (the Lombards took Ravenna in 751); Byzantium held only the Duchy of Rome and the Ravenna corridor.

people_region.caveat_zh: 568 年后托斯卡纳（图西亚）与斯波莱托公国属伦巴第；拜占庭仅保拉文纳—佩鲁贾—罗马走廊与五城，756 年起为教皇国。
people_region.caveat_en: After 568 Tuscany (Tuscia) and the Duchy of Spoleto were Lombard; Byzantium kept only the Ravenna–Perugia–Rome corridor and the Pentapolis, which became the Papal States from 756.

people_region.caveat_zh: 教皇国存续至 1870 年罗马并入意大利王国。
people_region.caveat_en: The Papal States survived until Rome joined the Kingdom of Italy in 1870.

people_region.caveat_zh: 托斯卡纳—拉齐奥北部为伊特鲁里亚人（本图未建模），此处按意大利语族诸部近似着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Tuscany and northern Lazio were Etruscan (not modeled here); the region is approximated by the Italic peoples.

people_region.caveat_zh: 哈塔伊（安条克）1098–1268 年属十字军安条克公国，本区按奇里乞亚亚美尼亚着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Hatay (Antioch) belonged to the Crusader Principality of Antioch in 1098–1268; the region is colored by Cilician Armenia.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1375–1517 马穆鲁克宗主下的土库曼拉马赞贝伊国；哈塔伊（安条克）1939 年前属叙利亚，阿拉伯—阿拉维人口众多。
people_region.caveat_en: Turkmen Ramadanid beylik under Mamluk suzerainty (1375–1517); Hatay (Antioch) belonged to Syria until 1939 and has a large Arab–Alawite population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 按人口多数着色，不涉政治归属。1897 与 1926 两次普查之间的主体交替年份按线性插值取 1900 年。
people_region.caveat_en: Coloured by population majority, regardless of political sovereignty. The changeover between the 1897 and 1926 censuses is linearly interpolated to 1900.

people_region.caveat_zh: 塞浦路斯诸城邦王国在波斯宗主下保有本地王统。
people_region.caveat_en: The city-kingdoms of Cyprus kept their native kings under Persian suzerainty.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1489–1571 威尼斯、1571–1878 奥斯曼、1878–1960 英国统治；按着色原则以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Venetian (1489–1571), Ottoman (1571–1878) and British (1878–1960) rule; following the coloring principle the island is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1974 年土耳其出兵后岛屿分治，北部「北塞浦路斯土耳其共和国」仅土耳其承认；本图塞浦路斯为整区，按全岛人口多数着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Since the Turkish intervention of 1974 the island has been divided; the northern "Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus" is recognized only by Turkey. Cyprus is a single region here, colored by the island-wide majority.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1551–1911 奥斯曼（1711–1835 卡拉曼利王朝自治）、1911–1943 意大利：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与殖民政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1551–1911 Ottoman (autonomous Karamanli dynasty 1711–1835), 1911–1943 Italian: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or colonial political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 大摩拉维亚（833–907）以摩拉维亚为核心，890–895 年领有波希米亚；本区斯拉夫人统一着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Great Moravia (833–907) was centered on Moravia and held Bohemia in 890–895; the Slavs of the region share one color.

people_region.caveat_zh: 克恩滕与施蒂利亚西部未入马扎尔人控制。
people_region.caveat_en: Carinthia and western Styria were not under Magyar control.

people_region.caveat_zh: 布尔根兰 1921 年前属匈牙利王国；克恩滕南部有斯洛文尼亚语人群。
people_region.caveat_en: Burgenland belonged to the Kingdom of Hungary until 1921; southern Carinthia has a Slovene-speaking population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 克恩滕—施蒂利亚为卡兰塔尼亚斯拉夫公国（7 世纪中叶脱离阿瓦尔，745 年起臣属巴伐利亚），悬停可见。
people_region.caveat_en: Carinthia–Styria formed the Slavic principality of Carantania (independent of the Avars from the mid-7th century, subject to Bavaria from 745); shown on hover.

people_region.caveat_zh: 多瑙河以北（魏因菲尔特尔、瓦尔德菲尔特尔）为马科曼尼—夸迪人，不属罗马。
people_region.caveat_en: North of the Danube (Weinviertel, Waldviertel) belonged to the Marcomanni and Quadi, not Rome.

people_region.caveat_zh: 多瑙河以北的卢吉兰（下奥地利）489 年后为伦巴第人所据。
people_region.caveat_en: Rugiland north of the Danube (Lower Austria) was held by the Lombards after 489.

people_region.caveat_zh: 按人口原则不画奥斯曼政治控制层，仅以土耳其裔/穆斯林少数族群层表示奥斯曼时代遗留人口。
people_region.caveat_en: Following the population principle, no Ottoman political-control layer is drawn; Ottoman-era populations are shown only as a Turkish/Muslim minority layer.

people_region.caveat_zh: 以现代族名标示先民人群：古爱沙尼亚诸部；近代爱沙尼亚民族认同形成于 19 世纪民族觉醒。
people_region.caveat_en: Modern ethnonym used for ancestral populations: the ancient Estonian tribes; modern Estonian national identity formed in the 19th-century national awakening.

people_region.caveat_zh: 以现代族名标示先民人群：芬兰本部、海米（塔瓦斯特）、卡累利阿诸部；近代芬兰民族认同形成于 19 世纪。
people_region.caveat_en: Modern ethnonym used for ancestral populations: Finns proper, Tavastians and Karelians; modern Finnish national identity formed in the 19th century.

people_region.caveat_zh: 前 278 年起凯尔特加拉太人在此定居建国（悬停可见），整区按希腊化世界近似着色。
people_region.caveat_en: From 278 BC the Celtic Galatians settled here and formed their own states (shown on hover); the region is approximated as part of the Hellenistic world.

people_region.caveat_zh: 以现代族名标示先民人群：加利西亚—莱昂王国的基督徒人口（加利西亚人未单列）；统一的「西班牙人」认同形成于近代早期。
people_region.caveat_en: Modern ethnonym used for ancestral populations: the Christian population of the Galician–Leonese kingdom (Galicians not listed separately); a unified Spanish identity formed in the early modern period.

people_region.caveat_zh: 基辅罗斯时代的东斯拉夫人统一标示为「罗斯人」，作为俄罗斯人、乌克兰人、白俄罗斯人的共同前身，不将基辅罗斯归属于其中任何一个现代民族。
people_region.caveat_en: East Slavs of the Kievan Rus' era are shown jointly as "Rus'", the common precursor of Russians, Ukrainians and Belarusians, without assigning Kievan Rus' to any one modern nation.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1574–1881 奥斯曼（1705 起侯赛因王朝自治）、1881–1956 法国保护国：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与殖民政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1574–1881 Ottoman (autonomous Husainid beys from 1705), 1881–1956 French protectorate: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or colonial political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 士麦那等沿海城市希腊裔人口众多，至 1922–1923 年。
people_region.caveat_en: Smyrna and other coastal towns had large Greek populations until 1922–1923.

people_region.caveat_zh: 前 6 世纪前内陆为吕底亚、卡里亚、弗里吉亚人（本图未建模），此处按沿海希腊城邦着色整区。
people_region.caveat_en: Before the 6th century BC the interior belonged to Lydians, Carians and Phrygians (not modeled); the region is colored by the coastal Greek cities.

people_region.caveat_zh: 12 世纪起赞吉（突厥）、阿尤布（库尔德）、马穆鲁克统治集团非阿拉伯人；1260–1303 年为蒙古—马穆鲁克拉锯区。
people_region.caveat_en: From the 12th century the Zengid (Turkic), Ayyubid (Kurdish) and Mamluk elites were not Arab; 1260–1303 was a Mongol–Mamluk battleground.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1516–1918 奥斯曼、1920–1946 法国委任统治；东北部库尔德人比例高：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与委任统治政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1516–1918 Ottoman, 1920–1946 French mandate; the northeast has a large Kurdish population: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or mandate political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 507 年后仅塞蒂马尼亚（朗格多克沿海，约本区东半）属西哥特，图卢兹已归法兰克。
people_region.caveat_en: After 507 only Septimania (coastal Languedoc, roughly the east of the region) remained Visigothic; Toulouse had passed to the Franks.

people_region.caveat_zh: 图卢兹伯国长期自治，1271 年并入法国王室；鲁西永 1659 年比利牛斯和约前属阿拉贡/西班牙（加泰罗尼亚语区）。
people_region.caveat_en: The County of Toulouse was long autonomous and joined the French crown in 1271; Roussillon belonged to Aragon/Spain (Catalan-speaking) until the Treaty of the Pyrenees in 1659.

people_region.caveat_zh: 最北的伊纳里、乌茨约基、埃农泰基厄以萨米人为主；1809 年前属瑞典王国，1809–1917 年属俄属芬兰大公国。本区按芬兰人着色，萨米人见悬停。
people_region.caveat_en: The northernmost municipalities of Inari, Utsjoki and Enontekiö remain mainly Sami; the area belonged to Sweden until 1809 and to the Russian Grand Duchy of Finland in 1809–1917. The region is colored Finnish; the Sami appear on hover.

people_region.caveat_zh: 以现代族名标示先民人群：拉特加尔、瑟洛、瑟米加利亚、库尔泽姆诸部在 13–17 世纪的利沃尼亚框架下逐步融合为拉脱维亚人。
people_region.caveat_en: Modern ethnonym used for ancestral populations: Latgalians, Selonians, Semigallians and Curonians gradually merged into Latvians within Livonia in the 13th–17th centuries.

people_region.caveat_zh: 卢森堡人以卢森堡语（摩泽尔法兰克方言）为母语，本图归入德意志人近似；1839 年起为独立国家。
people_region.caveat_en: Luxembourgers speak Luxembourgish (a Moselle Franconian dialect) and are approximated here as Germans; Luxembourg has been independent since 1839.

people_region.caveat_zh: 以现代族名「马其顿人」标示该地区自 7 世纪以来的斯拉夫人口，是人口连续标签，不是认同判断。现代马其顿民族认同形成于 19 世纪末至 20 世纪中（1903 年米西尔科夫著作、1944 年 ASNOM 宣告、1945 年标准语），保加利亚史学将此前人口视为保加利亚人。萨穆伊尔国家（976–1018）主流学术视为第一保加利亚帝国的延续。
people_region.caveat_en: The modern name "Macedonians" labels the Slavic population of this region since the 7th century as a continuity label, not a judgment of identity. Modern Macedonian national identity formed in the late 19th to mid-20th century (Misirkov 1903, ASNOM 1944, standard language 1945); Bulgarian historiography regards the earlier population as Bulgarian. Samuel's state (976–1018) is regarded by mainstream scholarship as a continuation of the First Bulgarian Empire.

people_region.caveat_zh: 马祖里人讲波兰语方言，但多数认同普鲁士（1920 年公投阿伦施泰因区逾 97% 选择留在东普鲁士），故单列而不归入波兰人；该地区按人口主色仍为德国人。
people_region.caveat_en: Masurians spoke a Polish dialect but mostly identified with Prussia (over 97% in the Allenstein area voted to remain in East Prussia in 1920), so they are listed separately rather than as Poles; by population the region's main colour remains German.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1556–1830 奥斯曼阿尔及尔摄政、1830–1962 法属阿尔及利亚：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与殖民政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1556–1830 Ottoman Regency of Algiers, 1830–1962 French Algeria: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or colonial political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 沿海有伊科西乌姆（阿尔及尔）、约尔（舍尔沙勒）、西加等布匿人城镇，处于迦太基霸权之下，努米底亚/毛里塔尼亚诸王多为其盟友；属势力范围而非领土统治，内陆按柏柏尔人着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Punic towns on the coast such as Icosium (Algiers), Iol (Cherchell) and Siga lay under Carthaginian hegemony, and the Numidian/Mauretanian kings were mostly its allies; this was a sphere of influence rather than territorial rule, so the interior is colored Berber.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1912–1956 年法国/西班牙保护国：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与殖民政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1912–1956 French/Spanish protectorate: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or colonial political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 沿海有利克苏斯、廷吉斯（丹吉尔）、鲁萨迪尔（梅利利亚）等布匿人城镇，处于迦太基霸权之下，努米底亚/毛里塔尼亚诸王多为其盟友；属势力范围而非领土统治，内陆按柏柏尔人着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Punic towns on the coast such as Lixus, Tingis (Tangier) and Rusaddir (Melilla) lay under Carthaginian hegemony, and the Numidian/Mauretanian kings were mostly its allies; this was a sphere of influence rather than territorial rule, so the interior is colored Berber.

people_region.caveat_zh: 诺曼底：911 年封予诺斯人罗洛（诺曼公国），1066–1204 年诺曼底公爵兼英格兰国王；百年战争中北法一度为英格兰占领（1420–1435）。本区按法兰西着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Normandy was granted to the Norseman Rollo in 911; its dukes were also kings of England in 1066–1204, and much of northern France was English-occupied in 1420–1435. The region is colored French.

people_region.caveat_zh: 塞萨洛尼基未失守；西蒙一世（893–927）时已据西马其顿一部。
people_region.caveat_en: Thessaloniki never fell; under Simeon I (893–927) Bulgaria had already held part of western Macedonia.

people_region.caveat_zh: 马其顿为保有本地王统的波斯附庸王国。
people_region.caveat_en: Macedon was a Persian vassal kingdom that kept its native kings.

people_region.caveat_zh: 塞萨洛尼基始终属拜占庭。
people_region.caveat_en: Thessaloniki remained Byzantine throughout.

people_region.caveat_zh: 塞萨洛尼基与沿海仍属拜占庭（7 世纪斯拉夫人与阿瓦尔人多次围攻塞萨洛尼基）；西马其顿斯拉夫语人群延续至近代。
people_region.caveat_en: Thessaloniki and the coast stayed Byzantine (besieged repeatedly by Slavs and Avars in the 7th century); Slavic speakers persisted in western Macedonia into modern times.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1387–1912 年奥斯曼统治（色萨利 1881、马其顿与伊庇鲁斯 1912–1913 年归希腊）；1923 年人口交换前为希腊人、斯拉夫语人群、土耳其人、阿罗蒙人与塞萨洛尼基塞法迪犹太人混居，各方统计有争议；本区按希腊人着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Ottoman rule 1387–1912 (Thessaly joined Greece in 1881, Macedonia and Epirus in 1912–1913). Before the 1923 population exchange the population mixed Greeks, Slavic speakers, Turks, Aromanians and the Sephardic Jews of Thessaloniki, in disputed proportions; the region is colored Greek.

people_region.caveat_zh: 拉文纳总督区（艾米利亚—罗马涅东部）与威尼斯潟湖属拜占庭至 751 年。
people_region.caveat_en: The Exarchate of Ravenna (eastern Emilia-Romagna) and the Venetian lagoon remained Byzantine until 751.

people_region.caveat_zh: 威尼斯共和国（至 1797）、西班牙米兰（1535–1714）、奥地利伦巴第—威尼托（1714/1815–1859/1866）；南蒂罗尔以德语人口为主（1919 年归意大利）。本区按意大利人着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The Republic of Venice (to 1797), Spanish Milan (1535–1714) and Austrian Lombardy–Venetia (1714/1815–1859/1866); South Tyrol is mainly German-speaking (Italian since 1919). The region is colored Italian.

people_region.caveat_zh: 高卢人入侵前及同期，伊特鲁里亚人（波河平原南部）、利古里亚人、威尼蒂人未单独建模。
people_region.caveat_en: Etruscans (southern Po Valley), Ligurians and Veneti, before and alongside the Gauls, are not modeled separately.

people_region.caveat_zh: 芬马克内陆（考特凯诺、卡拉绍克）至今以萨米人为多数；18–19 世纪克文人（芬兰移民）定居；1850 至 1980 年代推行挪威化政策。本区按挪威人着色，萨米人见悬停。
people_region.caveat_en: Inner Finnmark (Kautokeino, Karasjok) still has a Sami majority; Kvens (Finnish migrants) settled in the 18th–19th centuries; a Norwegianization policy ran from the 1850s to the 1980s. The region is colored Norwegian; the Sami appear on hover.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1529–1830 奥斯曼阿尔及尔摄政、1830–1962 法属阿尔及利亚；卡比利亚与奥雷斯山区以柏柏尔语人群为主：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与殖民政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1529–1830 Ottoman Regency of Algiers, 1830–1962 French Algeria; Kabylia and the Aurès remain predominantly Berber-speaking: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or colonial political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 沿海有希波（安纳巴）、鲁西卡德（斯基克达）、伊吉尔吉利（吉杰勒）等布匿人城镇，处于迦太基霸权之下，努米底亚/毛里塔尼亚诸王多为其盟友；属势力范围而非领土统治，内陆按柏柏尔人着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Punic towns on the coast such as Hippo Regius (Annaba), Rusicade (Skikda) and Igilgili (Jijel) lay under Carthaginian hegemony, and the Numidian/Mauretanian kings were mostly its allies; this was a sphere of influence rather than territorial rule, so the interior is colored Berber.

people_region.caveat_zh: 阿尤布（库尔德）、马穆鲁克（突厥—切尔克斯）统治集团非阿拉伯人；十字军沿海残余至 1291 年。
people_region.caveat_en: The Ayyubid (Kurdish) and Mamluk (Turkic–Circassian) elites were not Arab; a Crusader coastal remnant survived until 1291.

people_region.caveat_zh: 耶胡德行省为犹太人自治的第二圣殿时代。
people_region.caveat_en: The province of Yehud was a self-governing Jewish community of the Second Temple period.

people_region.caveat_zh: 前 37–前 4 年希律王国为罗马附庸王国（其后诸分封王至 44/100 年），按罗马着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The Herodian kingdom (37–4 BC, then tetrarchies to 44/100 AD) was a Roman client state and is colored as Roman.

people_region.caveat_zh: 本区为 303 年巴勒斯坦行省近似（含以色列、约旦河西岸、加沙，并含西奈与约旦南部），犹太人与阿拉伯人数量大致相当、政治归属有争议；按约定 1948 年起着色为犹太人，阿拉伯人见悬停第二层。
people_region.caveat_en: This region approximates the 303 province of Palaestina (Israel, the West Bank and Gaza, plus Sinai and southern Jordan); Jewish and Arab populations are roughly comparable and sovereignty is disputed. By project decision it is colored Jewish from 1948; Arabs appear as the second layer on hover.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1516–1917 奥斯曼、1917–1948 英国委任统治：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与委任统治政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1516–1917 Ottoman, 1917–1948 British mandate: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or mandate political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 前 732 年起新亚述、新巴比伦先后征服（前 586 年耶路撒冷陷落），本图无对应族群，以犹太人着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Neo-Assyria and Neo-Babylon conquered the land from 732 BC (Jerusalem fell in 586 BC); with no corresponding peoples here, it is colored Jewish.

people_region.caveat_zh: 本都王国为波斯系米特拉达梯王朝，希腊化宫廷；按希腊化世界近似着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The Pontic kingdom was ruled by the Persian-descended Mithridatic dynasty with a Hellenized court; it is colored as part of the Hellenistic world.

people_region.caveat_zh: 马穆鲁克（突厥—切尔克斯）统治集团非阿拉伯人。
people_region.caveat_en: The Mamluk (Turkic–Circassian) elite was not Arab.

people_region.caveat_zh: 推罗、西顿、比布鲁斯在波斯宗主下保有本地王统。
people_region.caveat_en: Tyre, Sidon and Byblos kept their native kings under Persian suzerainty.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1516–1918 奥斯曼（黎巴嫩山埃米尔国自治）、1920–1943 法国委任统治：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与委任统治政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1516–1918 Ottoman (autonomous Emirate of Mount Lebanon), 1920–1943 French mandate: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or mandate political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 前 9–前 6 世纪新亚述与新巴比伦先后为宗主（前 573 年尼布甲尼撒破推罗），本图无对应族群，以腓尼基诸城邦着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Neo-Assyria and Neo-Babylon held suzerainty in the 9th–6th centuries BC (Nebuchadnezzar took Tyre in 573 BC); with no corresponding peoples here, the cities are colored Phoenician.

people_region.caveat_zh: 本都希腊人与拉兹人在沿海长期存续，希腊裔至 1923 年人口交换。
people_region.caveat_en: Pontic Greeks and Laz remained numerous along the coast; the Greeks until the 1923 exchange.

people_region.caveat_zh: 普罗旺斯伯国属阿尔勒王国—神圣罗马帝国（1112–1245 巴塞罗那家族、1246 起安茹家族），1481 年并入法国；尼斯属萨伏依至 1860 年；科西嘉属比萨、热那亚（意大利语区）至 1768 年。本区按法兰西着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The County of Provence lay in the Kingdom of Arles/Holy Roman Empire (House of Barcelona 1112–1245, Anjou from 1246) and joined France in 1481; Nice was Savoyard until 1860, and Corsica belonged to Pisa and Genoa (Italian-speaking) until 1768. The region is colored French.

people_region.caveat_zh: 马萨利亚等希腊殖民城邦只控沿海，内陆为凯尔特—利古里亚人；此处按希腊城邦近似着色整区。
people_region.caveat_en: Massalia and the other Greek colonies held only the coast; the interior was Celto-Ligurian. The region is approximated by the Greek cities.

people_region.caveat_zh: 基辅罗斯时代的东斯拉夫人统一标示为「罗斯人」，作为俄罗斯人、乌克兰人、白俄罗斯人的共同前身，不将基辅罗斯归属于其中任何一个现代民族。
people_region.caveat_en: East Slavs of the Kievan Rus' era are shown jointly as "Rus'", the common precursor of Russians, Ukrainians and Belarusians, without assigning Kievan Rus' to any one modern nation.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1400 年为近似分界：东斯拉夫三族 14–16 世纪逐步分化，此前统一标示为「罗斯人」。
people_region.caveat_en: 1400 is an approximate boundary: the three East Slavic peoples differentiated gradually in the 14th–16th centuries and are shown jointly as "Rus'" before it.

people_region.caveat_zh: 西西里西部（莫提亚、帕诺尔摩斯、利利巴厄姆）为迦太基辖区；本图西西里为整区，按东部希腊城邦着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Western Sicily (Motya, Panormus, Lilybaeum) was a Carthaginian province; Sicily is a single region here and is colored by the eastern Greek cities.

people_region.caveat_zh: 以现代族名标示先民人群：匈牙利王国北部（上匈牙利）的斯拉夫人口；斯洛伐克民族认同形成于 18–19 世纪（贝尔诺拉克、什图尔的标准语运动）。
people_region.caveat_en: Modern ethnonym used for ancestral populations: the Slavic population of northern Hungary (Upper Hungary); Slovak national identity formed in the 18th–19th centuries (the Bernolák and Štúr standard-language movements).

people_region.caveat_zh: 斯拉夫人定居范围有争议：拜占庭始终保有雅典、科林斯、莫奈姆瓦夏、沿海与诸岛；此处按斯拉夫人着色整区，表示内陆大规模定居时期。
people_region.caveat_en: The extent of Slavic settlement is disputed: Byzantium always kept Athens, Corinth, Monemvasia, the coasts and the islands. The region is colored Slavic to mark the period of large-scale settlement in the interior.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1262 年后拉丁残余并存：阿凯亚公国至 1432 年、雅典公国（1311–1388 加泰罗尼亚佣兵团，此后佛罗伦萨阿恰约利家族至 1458）；威尼斯据伊奥尼亚群岛（1386–1797）与诸岛，罗得岛骑士团（1310–1522）；奥斯曼统治 1460–1830；14–15 世纪阿尔瓦尼特人（阿尔巴尼亚人）大量定居阿提卡与伯罗奔尼撒；十二群岛 1912–1947 年属意大利。本区按希腊人着色。
people_region.caveat_en: After 1262 Latin remnants survived: the Principality of Achaea until 1432 and the Duchy of Athens (the Catalan Company 1311–1388, then the Florentine Acciaioli to 1458); Venice held the Ionian Islands (1386–1797) and other islands, and the Knights Hospitaller held Rhodes (1310–1522); Ottoman rule 1460–1830; Arvanites (Albanians) settled widely in Attica and the Peloponnese in the 14th–15th centuries; the Dodecanese were Italian in 1912–1947. The region is colored Greek.

people_region.caveat_zh: 萨莱诺、卡普阿、贝内文托等伦巴第亲王国仍据坎帕尼亚与内陆。
people_region.caveat_en: The Lombard principalities of Salerno, Capua and Benevento still held Campania and the interior.

people_region.caveat_zh: 拜占庭保有卡拉布里亚、阿普利亚南端、那不勒斯与阿马尔菲；847–871 年巴里为阿拉伯酋长国。
people_region.caveat_en: Byzantium kept Calabria, southern Apulia, Naples and Amalfi; Bari was an Arab emirate in 847–871.

people_region.caveat_zh: 希腊城邦集中于沿海，内陆为萨谟奈人、卢卡尼亚人等奥斯坎语族（未建模）。
people_region.caveat_en: The Greek cities lay along the coasts; the interior belonged to Oscan-speaking Samnites and Lucanians (not modeled).

people_region.caveat_zh: 统治者依次为诺曼（1071 起）、霍亨斯陶芬、安茹、阿拉贡、西班牙总督（1504–1707）、奥地利、波旁两西西里，至 1860 年统一；按主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Rulers were successively Norman (from 1071), Hohenstaufen, Angevin, Aragonese, Spanish viceroys (1504–1707), Austrian and Bourbon (Two Sicilies) until unification in 1860; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 阿布加尔王朝或出自纳巴泰/阿拉伯系，王国以叙利亚语为文化语言。
people_region.caveat_en: The Abgarid dynasty may have been of Nabataean/Arab origin; the kingdom's cultural language was Syriac.

people_region.caveat_zh: 罗马—萨珊前线：363 年后东部（尼西比斯）属萨珊，本区按罗马侧着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Roman–Sasanian frontier: after 363 the east (Nisibis) belonged to the Sasanians; the region is colored by the Roman side.

people_region.caveat_zh: 埃德萨伯国（十字军，1098–1144）据本区西部（乌尔法—加济安泰普），按突厥侧近似着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The County of Edessa (Crusader, 1098–1144) held the west of the region (Urfa–Gaziantep); the region is approximated as Turkic.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1514–1918 奥斯曼；加济安泰普以土耳其人为主，尚勒乌尔法阿拉伯人众多：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与委任统治政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1514–1918 Ottoman; Gaziantep is mainly Turkish and Şanlıurfa has many Arabs: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or mandate political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 塞尔柱（1070 年代起，突厥）、赞吉（突厥）、阿尤布（库尔德）、马穆鲁克（突厥—切尔克斯）统治集团非阿拉伯人，本图按阿拉伯化的叙利亚国家近似着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The Seljuk (from the 1070s, Turkic), Zengid (Turkic), Ayyubid (Kurdish) and Mamluk (Turkic–Circassian) elites were not Arab; Syria is approximated as an Arabized state.

people_region.caveat_zh: 巴尔米拉帝国（270–272，芝诺比娅）短暂割据，本图无对应族群，按罗马着色。
people_region.caveat_en: The Palmyrene Empire (270–272, Zenobia) briefly broke away; no corresponding people exists here, so the region stays Roman.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1516–1918 奥斯曼、1920–1946 法国委任统治：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与委任统治政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1516–1918 Ottoman, 1920–1946 French mandate: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or mandate political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 前 732 年起新亚述、新巴比伦先后统治叙利亚，本图无对应族群，以本地阿拉米人着色。
people_region.caveat_en: Neo-Assyria and then Neo-Babylon ruled Syria from 732 BC; with no corresponding peoples here, Syria is colored by its native Arameans.

people_region.caveat_zh: 巴拉顿公国由斯拉夫王公治理，880 年代大摩拉维亚一度东扩至此。
people_region.caveat_en: The Balaton principality was ruled by Slavic princes; Great Moravia briefly extended here in the 880s.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1541–1686/1699 年南部与东部属奥斯曼布达帕夏辖区，西北为哈布斯堡「王室匈牙利」；按着色原则不画奥斯曼与哈布斯堡政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1541–1686/1699: the south and east belonged to the Ottoman eyalet of Buda, the northwest to Habsburg Royal Hungary; following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or Habsburg political layer is drawn and the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 473 年东哥特主力南下巴尔干后，本区为苏维汇、赫鲁利等部与东哥特意大利（504–535 据锡尔米乌姆—萨维亚）势力交错。
people_region.caveat_en: After the main Ostrogothic body left for the Balkans in 473, the region was contested among the Suebi, Heruli and Ostrogothic Italy (which held Sirmium–Savia in 504–535).

people_region.caveat_zh: 1516–1918 奥斯曼、1920–1946 法国/英国委任统治：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与委任统治政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1516–1918 Ottoman, 1920–1946 French/British mandates: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or mandate political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1800 年以前缺乏可靠普查数据，按统治者着色；1800 年起按人口多数着色（全图统一规则）。
people_region.caveat_en: Before 1800, for lack of reliable census data, coloured by ruling power; from 1800 by population majority (a map-wide rule).

people_region.caveat_zh: 1800 年起按人口多数着色（全图统一规则：有普查数据的近现代按人口，此前按统治者）。罗马尼亚人 1830–40 年代约 62.3%，1910 年 53.8%。
people_region.caveat_en: From 1800 coloured by population majority (map-wide rule: census-era by population, earlier by ruling power). Romanians were c. 62.3% in the 1830s–40s and 53.8% in 1910.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1223 年以前罗马尼亚人（弗拉赫人）是否已居住于此存在争议：达契亚—罗马延续论认为罗马化人口连续居住；移民论认为其 12–13 世纪起自多瑙河以南迁入。本图仅以低优先级层列出，不采纳任一说。
people_region.caveat_en: Whether Romanians (Vlachs) lived here before 1223 is disputed: Daco-Roman continuity theory holds a continuous Romanized population; immigrationist theory holds they arrived from south of the Danube from the 12th–13th century. Listed here only as a low-priority layer, endorsing neither view.

people_region.caveat_zh: 迦太基仅控制的黎波里塔尼亚沿海城市带，内陆为柏柏尔（利比亚）部落；此处按统治者近似着色整区。
people_region.caveat_en: Carthage held only the coastal Emporia of Tripolitania; the interior belonged to Berber (Libyan) tribes. The whole region is colored by ruler as an approximation.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1510–1551 西班牙/医院骑士团、1551–1911 奥斯曼（1711–1835 卡拉曼利王朝自治）、1911–1943 意大利：按着色原则不画奥斯曼与殖民政治层，以主体人群着色。
people_region.caveat_en: 1510–1551 Spain/Knights Hospitaller, 1551–1911 Ottoman (autonomous Karamanli dynasty 1711–1835), 1911–1943 Italian: following the coloring principle, no Ottoman or colonial political layer is drawn; the region is colored by its main population.

people_region.caveat_zh: 基辅罗斯时代的东斯拉夫人统一标示为「罗斯人」，作为俄罗斯人、乌克兰人、白俄罗斯人的共同前身，不将基辅罗斯归属于其中任何一个现代民族。
people_region.caveat_en: East Slavs of the Kievan Rus' era are shown jointly as "Rus'", the common precursor of Russians, Ukrainians and Belarusians, without assigning Kievan Rus' to any one modern nation.

people_region.caveat_zh: 1400 年为近似分界：东斯拉夫三族 14–16 世纪逐步分化，此前统一标示为「罗斯人」。
people_region.caveat_en: 1400 is an approximate boundary: the three East Slavic peoples differentiated gradually in the 14th–16th centuries and are shown jointly as "Rus'" before it.

people_region.caveat_zh: 沿海自 14 世纪由瑞典与芬兰（比尔卡尔）移民垦殖（皮特奥 1327 年建教区）；托尔讷河谷为芬兰语梅安基利人（托尔讷河谷人）。本区按瑞典人着色，萨米人见悬停。
people_region.caveat_en: The coast was colonized by Swedish and Finnish (Birkarl) settlers from the 14th century (Piteå parish 1327); the Torne valley is home to the Finnish-speaking Meänkieli (Tornedalians). The region is colored Swedish; the Sami appear on hover.

people_region.caveat_zh: 福拉尔贝格为阿勒曼尼人定居区。
